description: Summarises web automation test results in a date range: total tests, passed, failed, completed without a pass/fail mark, pass rate (passed over all tests, as the Insights page shows it), pass rate over tests marked passed or failed, average duration and distinct builds, grouped by status, browser, os, build, device or day. Computed from the automation test list (up to 5000 tests per call; the total is always exact).

fromDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 59 days (older results are not served). Defaults to 30 days before toDate.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group by. Defaults to status.

toDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: getAnalyticsData
title: Get Analytics Data
